info.title: Retail Bank Loan API (Mock)
info.description:
Practice API for **API automation** and demos.

**Flow (production-shaped):** **login** → **KYC** → **DRAFT** → **documents** (**POST …/documents**) → (**optional:** **NOT / credit-card** + **WILL_OPEN:** **POST …/metrobank-deposit-account/confirm** — required before **underwriting** **APPROVE**, **not** required before **submit**) → (**PEP Yes:** **POST …/compliance/pep-clearance** after documents, before submit — **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** Step **7b**) → **submit** → **processing/accept** (**IN_PROCESSING**) → **disclosures/acknowledge** → **credit-check** → **underwriting/start** (**IN_UNDERWRITING**) → **underwriting/decision** → optional **stipulations** → **funding/authorize** (**CLEARED_FOR_BOOKING**) → **fund** (**FUNDED**) → **disburse** (**ACTIVE**) → **payments** → **payoff** (**CLOSED**) → **logout**.

**Swagger UI** at **`/docs`** renders this file (**`/openapi.json`**); contract is the same as **`javascript/mock-server/openapi.json`** in the repo.

**Production alignment:** Extra steps mirror **ops intake**, **initial disclosures**, **underwriting queue**, **PEP/AML-style** intake gate, and **funding authorization** before booking. **Products:** **PERSONAL_LOAN** (Metrobank-style unsecured; **`metrobank_client_type`** + optional **POST …/metrobank-deposit-account/confirm** before **underwriting** **APPROVE**) and **HOME_LOAN** (Metrobank Home Loan — residential mortgage; **same** **`metrobank_client_type`** / **ADA** confirm rules as Personal Loan — **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5.0.1**). **Catalogue taxonomy** (**`GET /reference/loan-products`**): each row includes **`product_loan_type`** **`PERSONAL`** (consumer retail: unsecured, home, car-style products) or **`BUSINESS`** (commercial-only products when added) and **`loan_type`** (family slug: **`personal`**, **`home`**, **`car`**, …). Constants: **`javascript/lib/productLoanTaxonomy.js`**.

**Metrobank Home Loan lifecycle (phases 1–6):** The **`HOME_LOAN`** row on **`GET /reference/loan-products`** includes **`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`** (structured **Eligibility & Pre-Qualification** through **Loan Maturity & Closing**) — see component **`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase`** and **`LoanProductCatalogEntry.metrobank_lifecycle_phases`**. **`ApplicationOut`** and **`LoanOut`** add **`metrobank_home_loan_lifecycle_phase`** (**`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhaseState`**) — derived from **`status`** and **`loan.status`** (same **`title`** as the catalogue row for that **`phase`** number). Source: **`javascript/lib/loan-products/home-loan/homeLoanCatalog.js`** + **`metrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase.js`** + **`homeLoanLosValidation.js`** (**HOME_LOAN** **`POST …/documents`** checklist + application fees; **`POST …/home-loan/fees/booking`** before **`funding/authorize`**); Phase **1** rules are enforced in **`evaluateHomeLoanEligibility`**. **Phase map:** **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5.0** / §**5.0.1** (Home Loan E2E) / §**5.4**. **Postman:** **`postman/collection/Loan_Lifecycle_API.postman_collection.json`** — **Flow — Happy path** (Personal) and **Flow — Metrobank Home Loan** (§**7**).

**Auth:** All `/v1/*` routes except **GET /health**, **GET /reference/loan-products**, and **POST /auth/login** require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

**Ops headers (production-style):** Responses are tagged with **`X-Correlation-Id`**, **`X-Request-Id`** (echo or minted), **`X-API-Environment`** (default **sandbox**; set **`BANK_API_ENV`**), **`X-API-Revision`**, **`Cache-Control: no-store`**. Send **`X-Correlation-Id`** from the client to tie logs to your own trace (optional unless **`BANK_REQUIRE_CORRELATION_ID=1`**). Optional **`Idempotency-Key`** on **authenticated POST** retries: same key + same path + same body replays the first **2xx** (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); a different body with the same key returns **409**. Optional **`BANK_API_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`** (per client IP) returns **429** with **`Retry-After`**.

**Implementation:** **`javascript/mock-server/server.js`**. **Product logic (same repo):** **`javascript/lib/loanProductCatalog.js`** (catalogue + intake validation); **`javascript/lib/loan-products/computationRegistry.js`** dispatches **GET /reference/loan-computation-preview** to **`javascript/lib/loan-products/personal-loan/personalLoanComputation.js`** (**PERSONAL_LOAN**) and **`javascript/lib/loan-products/home-loan/homeLoanComputation.js`** (**HOME_LOAN**); **`javascript/lib/loan-products/registry.js`** dispatches eligibility; **`javascript/lib/loan-products/shared/borrowerAge.js`** — shared borrower age helpers. File map: **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**6**.

servers.description: Same host as this Swagger page

tags.name: Reference
tags.description: **Read-only catalogue** (product terms, rails, **`product_loan_type`** / **`loan_type`**) — **unauthenticated**. **`GET /reference/loan-products`**: **`HOME_LOAN`** includes **`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`** (six Metrobank mortgage phases, **`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase`** schema).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Session — **login** first; **Bearer** on all other `/v1` calls. Maps to authenticated channels in production.

tags.name: Onboarding
tags.description: **KYC / customer onboarding** before origination (**403** on create application if skipped). In production: CIP, KYC, AML — here **POST /onboarding/kyc** returns **VERIFIED** instantly.

tags.name: Applications
tags.description: **Intake** (**create** → **PATCH** → **documents**) → **optional Metrobank deposit confirm** (**PERSONAL_LOAN** and **HOME_LOAN** — **`POST …/metrobank-deposit-account/confirm`** when **`WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT`**) → **conditional PEP compliance** → **submit** → **ops** → **disclosures** → **credit** → **underwriting** → **decision** → **pre-close (stips)**. **HOME_LOAN** business phases **1–6** are documented on **`GET /reference/loan-products`** (**`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`**, **`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase`**); **`ApplicationOut`** includes derived **`metrobank_home_loan_lifecycle_phase`** (**`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhaseState`**) — omitted when **`status`** is **`DECLINED`**. **`ApplicationOut`** echoes **`pep_compliance_clearance_at`** and **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`**. See **docs/DOCUMENTATION.md** §5.0, §**5.0.1**, §5.4 / Step **7b**.

get.description: Platform liveness — no **Authorization** header. Matches typical **GET /health** behind an API gateway.

Approved **term_months** LOVs and representative limits — use before showing an application form. No auth in sandbox. Payload is built from **`javascript/lib/loanProductCatalog.js`** (**`LOAN_PRODUCTS_BY_CODE`** / **`buildLoanProductReferencePayload`**). Each **`products[]`** entry includes **`product_code`**, **`product_loan_type`** (**`PERSONAL`** or **`BUSINESS`**), **`loan_type`** (e.g. **`personal`**, **`home`**), LOVs, and limits — see **`LoanProductCatalogEntry`** and **`javascript/lib/productLoanTaxonomy.js`**. **`HOME_LOAN`** includes **`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`** (six Metrobank mortgage business phases) — schema **`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase`**; see **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5.0.1**.

**No auth.** Computes **total interest**, **monthly amortization**, **fees**, **net proceeds**, and **effective interest rate (annual %)** from the catalogue. **PERSONAL_LOAN:** add-on rate + EIR ( **`term_months`** **12|18|24|36** ). **HOME_LOAN** (set query **`product_code`** to **HOME_LOAN**; optional **`loan_purpose`** for Home Equity tier): **level annual %** buckets (**`pricing_model`:** **`LEVEL_ANNUAL_PERCENT_BY_LOCK_IN_BUCKET`**); **`term_months`** in **12–300** (12-step) per **`GET /reference/loan-products`**. Query: **`principal_cents`** (PHP centavos; within product min/max). Optional **`product_code`** defaults to **PERSONAL_LOAN**. Example (**Personal**): **`principal_cents=2000000`**, **`term_months=12`**. Example (**Home**): **`product_code=HOME_LOAN`**, **`loan_purpose=PURCHASE_HOUSE_AND_LOT`**, **`principal_cents=50000000`**, **`term_months=240`**. **Dispatch:** **`javascript/lib/loan-products/computationRegistry.js`** (**`computeLoanPreviewForProduct`**) — implementations **`javascript/lib/loan-products/personal-loan/personalLoanComputation.js`**, **`javascript/lib/loan-products/home-loan/homeLoanComputation.js`**.

parameters.name: product_code
parameters.description: Catalogue **product_code** for pricing (**HOME_LOAN** uses **`loan_purpose`** for Home Equity rate tier).

parameters.name: loan_purpose
parameters.description: Optional **HOME_LOAN** purpose code (e.g. **HOME_EQUITY_PERSONAL_CONSUMPTION**) for pricing tier — see **GET /reference/loan-products** → **purpose_options**.

parameters.name: principal_cents
parameters.description: Face amount in **PHP centavos** (must fall within catalogue min/max).

parameters.name: term_months
parameters.description: Amortization term in months — must be listed in the product **`allowed_term_months`** (e.g. **12–36** Personal Loan; **12–300** Home Loan in **12**-month steps).

post.description: Public. Returns **access_token** — click **Authorize** in Swagger and paste `Bearer <token>` or only the token. Passwords accepted in sandbox: **demo** or **demo123** (any email).
Ends the session; the same token cannot be reused.

get.description:
Returns user id, email, and whether KYC is complete.

**Not public:** you must send **`Authorization: Bearer`** with the **`access_token`** from **POST /auth/login**. In Swagger: click **Authorize** (top), paste the token, **Authorize**, then **Try it out** here. The auto-generated **curl** only includes that header **after** you have authorized — otherwise you will see **401**.

401.description: Missing or invalid Bearer token — login first, then add the header or use **Authorize**

get.description: Same as **GET /auth/me** for KYC flags: requires **Bearer** token from **POST /auth/login** (Swagger **Authorize**).

post.description: **Required** before **POST /loan-applications**. Sandbox always returns **VERIFIED**.

**Application intake** — first LOS step after KYC. Creates **DRAFT** with **`loan_id: null`** until **POST …/underwriting/decision** creates the loan (see **docs/DOCUMENTATION.md** §5.4). Requires **completed KYC** (otherwise **403**). For **PERSONAL_LOAN** and **HOME_LOAN**, **metrobank_client_type** is **`EXISTING_CLIENT_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT`**, **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`**, or **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** (see **GET /reference/loan-products** → **metrobank_client_prerequisite**). **ADA** uses a **Metrobank deposit account** for repayments; **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** and **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`** may **create** and **submit** without **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`**, but **APPROVE** / **CONDITIONAL** return **422** until deposit is confirmed (or **`EXISTING_CLIENT_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT`**). Optional **`metrobank_deposit_repayment_plan`** when absent; valid enum when provided; after documents, **POST …/metrobank-deposit-account/confirm** applies when **`WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT`**. **HOME_LOAN** — Metrobank’s six business phases (eligibility through closing) are described on the **`HOME_LOAN`** catalogue row as **`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`** (**`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase`** schema); Phase **1** rules are enforced by **`evaluateHomeLoanEligibility`** — see **docs/DOCUMENTATION.md** §**5.0.1**.

200.description: Created **DRAFT** application. **`loan_id` is always `null` here** — the bank only creates a loan record after **POST …/underwriting/decision** (approve or conditional). Use **`application.id`** until then.

post.description: **Dry-run** the same validation and **eligibility criteria** as **POST /loan-applications** (intake Steps 1–6). Does **not** create a draft. Use after **Additional information** review and before **document upload** / create. Requires **KYC**. **metrobank_client_type** and **metrobank_deposit_repayment_plan** semantics match **POST /loan-applications**.

patch.description: Merge **principal_cents**, **term_months**, **metrobank_client_type**, **borrower**, and/or **employment** into an existing **DRAFT**. Re-validates catalogue rules and **eligibility**. **PATCH** that merges **additional_information** clears **`pep_compliance_clearance_at`** and **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`**. Changing **`metrobank_client_type`** clears **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`**. **403** if not owner; **409** if not **DRAFT**.

delete.description: Removes a **DRAFT** owned by the session. **409** if **`status`** is not **DRAFT**, or if the draft is younger than the minimum retention (**60** seconds by default — configure **`DRAFT_MIN_RETENTION_MS`** on the mock); retention **409** includes **`Retry-After`** (seconds) and **Problem Details** fields (**type**, **title**, **retry_after_seconds**). **404** after removal or if already auto-expired (default **3** min idle; **`DRAFT_SYSTEM_CANCEL_AFTER_MS`** overrides, **0** / **off** disables). Successful cancels are logged server-side (**`[audit] draft_cancelled`**). Optional **Idempotency-Key** replays **204**.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: **true** when this response was replayed from an earlier **Idempotency-Key**

404.description: Not found (or expired per server policy)

409.description: Not **DRAFT**, or minimum retention not met

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before **DELETE** may succeed (retention **409** only)

get.summary: Personal loan payment preview from application
get.description: Same body as **GET /reference/loan-computation-preview**, but **principal_cents** and **term_months** are taken from the borrower’s **DRAFT** (or later) application — no query params. Requires **Bearer**; only the session that **created** the application may call (**403** otherwise). Includes **`application_id`** in the response.

post.description: Confirms the borrower’s **primary_id_document_type** for upload matches **borrower.primary_id_document_type** on the application (**422** if not — e.g. declared **SSS** but selected **TIN**). Call after edits (**PATCH**) so the upload matches the **current** declared ID. **403** if not owner; **409** if not **DRAFT**. **HOME_LOAN:** also send **`home_loan_document_checklist`** (all required keys **true** per applicant profile — **`homeLoanLosValidation.js`**), **`home_loan_property_region`**, **`home_loan_title_investigation_title_count`**, and **`home_loan_application_fee_payments`** matching catalogue non-refundable fees.

422.description: Missing field, unknown ID type, or mismatch with declared borrower ID

post.summary: HOME_LOAN — record post-approval booking fee lines (LOS)
post.description: After **underwriting** **APPROVE** / **CONDITIONAL** with loan **PENDING_FUNDING**, record handling fee, notarial (per document × count), and acknowledgements for **DST**, **MRI**, and **property insurance** (quoting notes in catalogue). **Required** before **POST /v1/loans/{loanId}/funding/authorize** for **HOME_LOAN**. **422** if amounts do not match **`GET /reference/loan-products`** → **fees_and_charges.after_approval**.

409.description: Wrong product, loan status, or application status

post.summary: PEP / enhanced due diligence clearance (before submit)
post.description: **Production-shaped gate** when **Step 6** indicates **Yes** to **`pep_close_family_or_public_position`** or **`pep_financial_transactions_on_behalf`**. Call **after** **POST …/documents** and **before** **submit**. **400** if neither PEP boolean is **true**. **409** if still **DRAFT** but documents are not registered. Idempotent: repeated calls refresh **`pep_compliance_clearance_at`**. **PATCH** to **additional_information** clears prior clearance.

409.description: **Not DRAFT**, or document intake not completed

400.description: PEP clearance not applicable (both Step 6 answers **No**)

post.summary: Confirm Metrobank deposit account opening for ADA (before underwriting approval)
post.description: For **PERSONAL_LOAN** or **HOME_LOAN** with **`metrobank_client_type`:** **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** or **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`** and **`additional_information.metrobank_deposit_repayment_plan`:** **`WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT`**, call **after** **POST …/documents** while status is **DRAFT**, **SUBMITTED**, **IN_PROCESSING**, **CREDIT_COMPLETED**, or **IN_UNDERWRITING** (before **APPROVE** / **CONDITIONAL**). Re-runs **eligibility** (**422** if capacity-to-pay fails). **400** if not required; **409** if documents incomplete or plan is not **WILL_OPEN**. Sets **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`** (cleared when **PATCH** merges **additional_information** or changes **`metrobank_client_type`**). **Submit** does **not** require this; **underwriting** **APPROVE** / **CONDITIONAL** do until **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`** is set.

409.description: **Wrong status** (not allowed before underwriting approval), document intake incomplete, or repayment plan incompatible

post.description: For **PERSONAL_LOAN** and **HOME_LOAN**, **POST …/documents** must have completed first (**409** otherwise). **Metrobank deposit confirm** is **not** a **submit** gate (**APPROVE** / **CONDITIONAL** still **422** without **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`** when **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** or **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`** with **`WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT`**). When **additional_information** has **either** PEP boolean **true**, **POST …/compliance/pep-clearance** must have completed first (**409** otherwise).

409.description: Invalid state (not **DRAFT**), document intake incomplete (**Personal Loan**), or **PEP** compliance gate not cleared

post.description: **SUBMITTED** → **IN_PROCESSING** — processing / loan ops has accepted the file (mirrors LOS intake after borrower submit).

**IN_PROCESSING** only. Sets **`disclosures_acknowledged_at`** (sandbox: required before **credit-check** — Reg-TILA-style gate). Optional JSON body for demos, e.g. **`package_version`** (ignored by validation). Repeat calls are idempotent.

Requires **IN_PROCESSING** and **`disclosures_acknowledged_at`** set (call **processing/accept** then **disclosures/acknowledge**). **Once** per application — success → **CREDIT_COMPLETED** or **DECLINED**; calling again returns **409**.

409.description: Must be IN_PROCESSING with disclosures acknowledged

post.description: **CREDIT_COMPLETED** → **IN_UNDERWRITING** — assigns the file to underwriting before **POST …/underwriting/decision**.

**APPROVE** / **CONDITIONAL** return **422** when **Personal Loan** or **Home Loan** Metrobank deposit policy is not satisfied (e.g. **NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT** without **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`** when **`WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT`**, or credit-card-only path without confirm).

200.description: Application + loan (or **loan: null** if declined). **stipulations** is **[]** after straight **APPROVE**; after **CONDITIONAL** it lists items with **id**, **description**, **fulfilled** (use **id** in fulfill path).

409.description: Must be IN_UNDERWRITING (call POST …/underwriting/start after credit)

422.description: Invalid outcome, missing stips, or **Personal Loan** Metrobank deposit / ADA policy blocks approval

post.description: **One-shot alternative** to calling **POST …/stipulations/{stipulationId}/fulfill** repeatedly. Valid only when **`application.status`** is **APPROVED_CONDITIONAL** and **`loan.status`** is **PENDING_STIPS**. Marks **every** stipulation **`fulfilled: true`**, then moves the application to **APPROVED_CLEAR_TO_CLOSE** and the loan to **PENDING_FUNDING** (same end state as clearing the last stip individually). Returns **`fulfilled_stipulation_ids`** (all stipulation UUIDs on the application). **Do not use** after straight **APPROVE** — use **fund** directly.

fulfilled_stipulation_ids.description: Every **`id`** from **`application.stipulations`** after all are marked fulfilled.

409.description: Not APPROVED_CONDITIONAL / not PENDING_STIPS / nothing left to fulfill

post.description:
**When to use this:** only after **CONDITIONAL** underwriting, when **`application.stipulations`** lists items with **`fulfilled: false`**. **Do not use** if you chose straight **APPROVE** (stipulations were **[]** — go straight to **fund**). To clear **all** open stips in **one** request, use **POST …/stipulations/fulfill-all** instead.

**stipulationId:** copy the real **`id`** from the underwriting response (a **UUID**). The docs example uses a sample UUID; your runtime value comes from **Try it out** on underwriting — expand **`application.stipulations[0].id`** in the response body.

parameters.name: stipulationId
parameters.description: UUID from `application.stipulations[n].id` in the **underwriting** response (CONDITIONAL path).

post.description: **PENDING_FUNDING** → **CLEARED_FOR_BOOKING** — funding desk / secondary approval (mirrors production **clear-to-fund** before **GL** booking). Sets **`funding_authorized_at`**. Call **POST …/fund** next. **HOME_LOAN:** **422** unless **POST …/home-loan/fees/booking** has recorded booking fee lines on the linked application.

Books the obligation (**CLEARED_FOR_BOOKING** → **FUNDED**). Requires **POST …/funding/authorize** first when the loan was **PENDING_FUNDING**. Response includes **`funded_at`**. Next: **POST …/disburse**.

200.description: Loan is FUNDED (not yet disbursed to borrower)

post.description: Releases proceeds to the borrower (**FUNDED** → **ACTIVE**), e.g. wire/ACH; repayment/servicing usually applies from here. Requires **fund** first. Response includes **`disbursed_at`**.

409.description: Loan must be FUNDED (call fund first)

correlationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
correlationId.description: End-to-end correlation (W3C **traceparent**-adjacent pattern). Omit to let the server mint one; echo is returned on the response.

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: On **authenticated POST**, duplicate key + same JSON body replays the first successful response (different body → **409**). On **DELETE** `/v1/loan-applications/{applicationId}`, same key + path replays the first successful **204** (response header **Idempotent-Replayed: true**).

MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhaseState.description: Current Metrobank Home Loan business phase (**`HOME_LOAN`** only) — derived from **`application.status`** and **`loan.status`**. **`title`** matches **`GET /reference/loan-products`** → **`HOME_LOAN`** → **`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`** for the same **`phase`** number. Omitted when **`application.status`** is **`DECLINED`**. Implementation: **`javascript/lib/loan-products/home-loan/metrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase.js`**.

title.description: Same **`title`** as the catalogue phase for **`phase`**

MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase.description: One business phase in the Metrobank Home Loan journey (**`HOME_LOAN`** only). Present in **`GET /reference/loan-products`** → **`products[]`** where **`product_code`** is **`HOME_LOAN`**. Aligns with **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`** §**5.0.1** and **`homeLoanCatalog.js`** field **`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`**. **`ApplicationOut`** / **`LoanOut`** echo the current phase via **`metrobank_home_loan_lifecycle_phase`** (**`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhaseState`**). Not a separate HTTP resource — the practice API maps these to **`/loan-applications`** and **`/loans`** routes.

summary.description: Optional — how this phase relates to **`evaluateHomeLoanEligibility`**, fees, or API steps

bullets.description: Checklist bullets (citizenship, docs, appraisal, NOA/LOG, ADA, title release, …)

application_id.description: Present only on **GET /loan-applications/{applicationId}/computation-preview** — echoes the application used for inputs.

LoanProductCatalogEntry.description: Single **GET /reference/loan-products** row (PHP). **product_loan_type** = consumer (**PERSONAL**) vs commercial (**BUSINESS**). **loan_type** = product family (**personal**, **home**, **car**, …) within that taxonomy. **`HOME_LOAN`** rows include **`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`** (six phases) and related fields (**`citizenship_options`**, **`loan_requirements`**, …) — see **`MetrobankHomeLoanLifecyclePhase`**.

product_loan_type.description: **PERSONAL** — retail consumer (Personal Loan, Home Loan, Car Loan, …). **BUSINESS** — commercial / SME only.

loan_type.description: Product family within **product_loan_type** — e.g. **personal** (unsecured), **home** (mortgage), **car** (auto); **BUSINESS** rows use **product_loan_type** **BUSINESS** with a commercial **loan_type** when added.

metrobank_lifecycle_phases.description: **HOME_LOAN** only — Metrobank mortgage lifecycle (**1** Eligibility … **6** Maturity & closing). Omitted on **PERSONAL_LOAN**.

status.description: NOT_STARTED until KYC submitted, then VERIFIED in sandbox

PresentHomeAddressIn.description: **Present Home Address** (Step 4). **Canonical:** **street_line**, **province**, **city_town**, **barangay**, **postal_code** — the four geographic fields + ZIP must match one row in **GET /reference/loan-products** → **philippine_address_sample_rows** (sandbox sample of dependent PH LOVs). **Legacy:** **line1**, **city**, **province_region**, **postal_code** if **street_line** is omitted.

street_line.description: **No./Blk./St.** — letters and spaces only (no digits or special characters); 1–30 chars; no leading/trailing spaces.

subdivision_village.description: **Subdivision/Village** — optional; same character rules as **street_line** when provided.

postal_code.description: **ZIP Code** — 4-digit integer string; must match the Province/City/Barangay combination.

home_ownership.description: **Home Ownership** — optional; labels on **GET /reference/loan-products** → **home_ownership_options** (e.g. Living with Parents/Relatives, Owned, Rented).

line1.description: Legacy **street** line when not using **street_line** / triplet shape.

city.description: Legacy — maps to City/Town when using **line1** shape.

province_region.description: Legacy — maps to Province when using **line1** shape.

EmployerAddressIn.description: **Employer Address** (Step 5). **No./Blk./St.**, optional **Subdivision/Building**, **Province**, **City/Town**, **Barangay**, **ZIP** — the geographic quad + **postal_code** must match one row in **GET /reference/loan-products** → **philippine_address_sample_rows** (same dependent rules as **Present Home Address**). **Required** when **`employment.status`** is **EMPLOYED**.

street_line.description: **No./Blk./St.** — letters and spaces only; 1–30 chars; no leading/trailing spaces.

subdivision_building.description: **Subdivision/Building** — optional; same character rules as **street_line** when provided.

province.description: **Province** — pairs with city, barangay, ZIP per reference rows.

postal_code.description: **ZIP Code** — 4-digit string matching the Province/City/Barangay row.

HomePhoneIn.description: Optional landline (**home** or **business**): **area_code** + **subscriber_number** (8 digits). **area_code** must be in **GET /reference/loan-products** → **landline_area_code_options** (**002**–**088** or **0882**). If either field is sent, send both.

Step3PrimaryIdDocumentType.description: **Step 3** “Choose an ID” — basic-details subset. **POST /loan-applications** accepts only these; **PATCH** may set any **PrimaryIdDocumentType** value before document upload. Mirrors **GET /reference/loan-products** → **step3_primary_id_document_types**.

AdditionalInformationIn.description: Step 6 PEP-style questions (both mandatory **boolean**; UI often defaults **false**). **Either `true`:** after **POST …/documents**, **`POST …/compliance/pep-clearance`** is **required** before **submit** in this sandbox (**409** otherwise). When **`metrobank_client_type`** is **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** or **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`**, **`metrobank_deposit_repayment_plan`** is **optional**; if present it must be a valid enum **string** in JSON (e.g. `"metrobank_deposit_repayment_plan": "WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT"` — unquoted enum tokens are invalid). Deposit confirmation for **`WILL_OPEN`** is required before **underwriting** **APPROVE** — see **`POST …/metrobank-deposit-account/confirm`**. See **docs/DOCUMENTATION.md** (Step 6–7b).

pep_close_family_or_public_position.description: Family/self close relationship with prominent public or international-org position. **`true`:** typically starts **EDD** / Compliance workflow in production.

pep_financial_transactions_on_behalf.description: Substantial domestic/international financial transactions on behalf of such a person. **`true`:** typically starts **EDD** / Compliance workflow in production.

metrobank_deposit_repayment_plan.description: Optional when **`metrobank_client_type`** is **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** or **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`** (valid enum if sent). JSON: always a **quoted** string. Only **`WILL_OPEN_METROBANK_DEPOSIT`** can use **POST …/metrobank-deposit-account/confirm**; **APPROVE** / **CONDITIONAL** **422** without confirm (or **`EXISTING_CLIENT_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT`**).

property_appraised_value_cents.description: **HOME_LOAN** — collateral **appraisal** face value (**PHP centavos**); used for LTV checks vs **principal_cents**.

home_loan_applicant_category.description: **HOME_LOAN** — affects maximum **term_months** (e.g. 15y OFW caps). When **OFW**, **`ofw_employment_basis`** is **required** (**LAND_BASED** or **SEA_BASED**); sea-based requires **`ofw_sea_contract_months_total`**.

ofw_employment_basis.description: **HOME_LOAN** + **OFW** only — land-based: ≥2 years with current employer; sea-based: ≥24 months total contract (**ofw_sea_contract_months_total**).

collateral_is_vacant_lot.description: **HOME_LOAN** — **true** when collateral is vacant land (stricter term/LTV rules).

no_adverse_credit_history.description: **HOME_LOAN** — declare **true** when borrower attests no adverse credit findings (eligibility).

home_equity_for_improvement.description: **HOME_LOAN** — when **loan_purpose** is **HOME_EQUITY_PERSONAL_CONSUMPTION**, **true** selects longer max term (home improvement).

BorrowerConsentsIn.description: All three must be **true** (sandbox mirrors checkbox gate).

PrimaryIdDocumentType.description: **Step 7** upload picker and **PATCH**-allowed declared IDs — full LOV (**GET /reference/loan-products** → **primary_id_document_types** per **`product_code`**). **DocumentRegistrationIn** / upload must match **borrower.primary_id_document_type**. Synced with product rows in **`javascript/lib/loanProductCatalog.js`** (e.g. **`PERSONAL_LOAN_PRIMARY_ID_DOCUMENT_TYPES`**; **HOME_LOAN** has its own list — see repo tests).

BorrowerIn.description: Alternative: send **full_name** instead of **first_name**/**last_name** — server accepts either pattern (see **`validatePersonalLoanIntakeShape`**). OpenAPI lists structured names as canonical.

first_name.description: Letters and spaces; trimmed; 1–30 chars; no leading/trailing spaces.

middle_name.description: Optional. When present: **1–30** characters, letters and spaces only (no digits or punctuation), single spaces between words; **no** leading or trailing spaces. Omit or leave empty to skip.

full_name.description: Legacy single field if structured names are omitted (letters/spaces, trimmed).

date_of_birth.description: **YYYY-MM-DD** — must be strictly **before** today (past date of birth).

citizenship.description: **Citizenship** — **PERSONAL_LOAN:** **FILIPINO** only (server validation). **HOME_LOAN:** **FILIPINO** or **FOREIGNER_PERMANENT_RESIDENT** (permanent resident visa). See **GET /reference/loan-products** → **citizenship_options** on the **HOME_LOAN** row.

primary_id_document_number.description: Declared ID number — **11 digits** in this sandbox.

education.description: **Education** — dropdown + search in production; labels on **GET /reference/loan-products** → **education_options** (College/Graduate, Grade School, …).

place_of_birth.description: **Place of Birth** — 3–30 chars, letters and spaces only (no digits or special characters); no leading/trailing spaces.

home_loan_document_checklist.description: **HOME_LOAN** — required. Each key from **`getRequiredHomeLoanDocumentKeys`** (see **`homeLoanLosValidation.js`**) must be **`true`** (document line received).

home_loan_title_investigation_title_coun.description: **HOME_LOAN** — number of titles × catalogue per-title investigation fee.

home_loan_application_fee_payments.description: **HOME_LOAN** — must exactly match computed non-refundable fees from **`home_loan_property_region`** and **`home_loan_title_investigation_title_count`**.

dst_acknowledged.description: Borrower acknowledges DST per BIR / branch (rate not fixed in mock).

EmploymentIn.description: Metrobank **Employment details** — **source_of_funds** and **employment_status** per **GET /reference/loan-products**. **source_of_funds** must align with **status** (**EMPLOYED** / **SELF_EMPLOYED**). When **EMPLOYED**: **employer_name**, **employer_address** (**EmployerAddressIn**, PH reference row), **years_with_current_employer**, **is_regular_employment**. When **SELF_EMPLOYED**: **business_name**, **years_in_current_business** (no **employer_address**). Optional **business_mobile_phone** (PH mobile) and **business_phone** (same **area_code** + **subscriber_number** landline as **HomePhoneIn**).

gross_monthly_income_cents.description: **PHP centavos** — **Gross Monthly Income**; ×12 must meet product **min_annual_income_cents** (PHP **250,000**/year minimum).

business_phone.description: Optional **Business Phone** — **area_code** (**002–088**) + **subscriber_number** (8 digits); both if either is sent.

product_code.description: **PERSONAL_LOAN** (Metrobank-style unsecured) or **HOME_LOAN** (residential mortgage). **GET /v1/reference/loan-products** lists each code with **`product_loan_type`** and **`loan_type`** on the catalogue row (both current products are **`PERSONAL`** retail; future **BUSINESS** / commercial codes use **`product_loan_type`:** **`BUSINESS`**).

principal_cents.description: **PHP centavos**; whole pesos (**divisible by 100**). Range: product **min_principal_cents**–**max_principal_cents**.

term_months.description: Amortization term — must appear in the product **`allowed_term_months`** (Personal: **12|18|24|36**; Home: **12…300** step **12**).

metrobank_client_type.description: Required for **PERSONAL_LOAN** and **HOME_LOAN**. **ADA** / deposit confirm rules — **GET /reference/loan-products** → **metrobank_client_prerequisite**.

loan_purpose.description: Must align with **product_code** — Personal vs Home purpose LOVs on the catalogue row.

ApplicationPatchIn.description: Any subset of application fields to merge into a **DRAFT**.

failed_checks.description: Human-readable criteria that failed — same labels returned as **422** on create/PATCH when ineligible.

StipulationOut.description: Outstanding underwriting requirement. **id** is used in POST …/stipulations/{stipulationId}/fulfill.

ApplicationOut.description: Application record. `loan_id` stays null until underwriting creates the loan.

metrobank_home_loan_lifecycle_phase.description: Present when **`product_code`** is **`HOME_LOAN`** and **`status`** is not **`DECLINED`** — current business phase (**1–6**) derived from **`status`** and linked **`loan`** (if any). See **`GET /reference/loan-products`** → **`metrobank_lifecycle_phases`**.

id.description: Application id — use this for submit, credit, underwriting paths.

draft_created_at.description: When the **DRAFT** was created (**POST /loan-applications**). Used for minimum retention before **DELETE** or optional system expiry.

metrobank_client_type.description: Captured at intake. **Credit card** and **NOT** paths that open deposit for **ADA** set **`metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at`** via confirm **POST**.

employment.description: Captured at Step 5; echoed on reads.

document_intake.description: Set by **POST …/documents**; cleared when **borrower.primary_id_document_type** changes via **PATCH**. **HOME_LOAN:** includes **`home_loan`** (checklist + verified application-phase fees).

home_loan_booking_fees.description: **HOME_LOAN** — post-approval booking lines recorded via **POST …/home-loan/fees/booking**; required before **POST …/loans/{loanId}/funding/authorize**.

loan_id.description: Loan id — **only set after a successful POST /underwriting/decision** that creates a loan. **Null** on a new draft from POST /loan-applications (there is no loan yet).

stipulations.description: **[]** after straight **APPROVE**. After **CONDITIONAL**, each item has **id**, **description**, **fulfilled** (see examples on underwriting response).

pep_compliance_clearance_at.description: Compliance/CFT gate — set by **POST …/compliance/pep-clearance** when PEP is **Yes**; nulled when **PATCH** merges **additional_information**.

metrobank_deposit_account_confirmed_at.description: Set by **POST …/metrobank-deposit-account/confirm** when **`NOT_METROBANK_CLIENT`** or **`EXISTING_CLIENT_CREDIT_CARD`** commits to opening a Metrobank deposit account for **ADA**; cleared when **PATCH** merges **additional_information** or changes **metrobank_client_type**.

StipulationIn.description: Each item adds one outstanding requirement. **`description`** is free text — the sandbox does **not** enforce a fixed list. For a long **copy-paste list** of demo descriptions, see **`docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` §5.2 and `javascript/lib/loanConstants.js`** (`STIPULATION_DESCRIPTION_EXAMPLES`).

description.description: Human-readable stipulation line shown to ops/borrower. Examples: "Proof of income (W-2)", "Signed disclosures", "Insurance binder" — any wording is accepted.

metrobank_home_loan_lifecycle_phase.description: Present when **`product_code`** is **`HOME_LOAN`** — same derivation as **`ApplicationOut`** (via **`application_id`**). **null** in schema terms = field omitted for non-**HOME_LOAN** products.

status.description: **Sandbox loan status machine:** **PENDING_STIPS** → **PENDING_FUNDING** → **CLEARED_FOR_BOOKING** → **FUNDED** → **ACTIVE** → **PAID_OFF** → **CLOSED**. **funding/authorize** sits between clear-to-close and booking. See **docs/DOCUMENTATION.md** §5.4.

disbursed_at.description: Set when **disburse** succeeds (proceeds sent). **null** until then.

method.description: **ACH** — NACHA ACH credit/debit to customer DDA (typical installment). **WIRE** — domestic wire (e.g. Fedwire-style) for payoffs or same-day funds.

payment_method.description: Echo of the validated **method** from the request.

ErrorBody.description: JSON error payload; **type** / **title** follow RFC 7807-style **Problem Details** where applicable.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the problem.

correlation_id.description: Same value as response header **X-Correlation-Id** — cite in support tickets.

retry_after_seconds.description: Echo of **Retry-After** hint: **429** (rate limit) or **409** (**DELETE** draft retention).
